# Vendor React Over the Babel CDN

**Decision.** Commit React and ReactDOM's production UMD builds into the repository and precompile
`sn-app.jsx` to `sn-app.js` ahead of time, rather than loading Babel from a CDN and transpiling JSX
in the browser.

**Date.** Committed 2026-07-10 as `06b5882 Make SentinelNet run offline: vendor React, precompile the
JSX` — 2,692 insertions.

## Why

The CDN approach did not merely degrade offline, it produced nothing at all:

> "It used to be loaded through the Babel CDN with `type=\"text/babel\"`, so opening it directly
> (`file://`) left a **blank page** — the browser blocks Babel from fetching the local `.jsx`, and
> there was no internet fallback."
> — Discrete-Mathematics-Laboratories/lab5_GraphTheory/README.md, 2026-07-10

Two independent failures stacked: the CDN needs the network, and in-browser Babel needs to `fetch()`
the `.jsx` file, which `file://` origin rules forbid. A deliverable that must open by double-click on
a marker's machine — [[offline-first-static-deliverable]] — cannot depend on either.

## Alternatives rejected

| Option | Why not |
|---|---|
| **Babel CDN + `text/babel`** | the incumbent; blank page on `file://`, no offline fallback |
| **A local dev server** | moves the failure to "the reader must start a server"; defeats double-click delivery |
| **A bundler (Vite/esbuild)** | introduces `node_modules` and a build the reader must run |
| **Drop React, use vanilla JS** | what `lab4/part2` and `lab6/viewer` already do — not taken here |

**TODO:** how the blank page was discovered (a failed demo? marking?) and whether a dev server or
bundler was actually tried before committing the precompiled output is not recorded anywhere.
`confidence: low` on the process; `confidence: high` on the decision and its stated reason.

## The safeguard that makes it survivable

Committing generated output invites drift, so the source relationship is written down:

> "`sn-app.jsx` remains the **source of truth**. To rebuild `sn-app.js` after editing it, transpile
> the JSX (any Babel with `preset-react`)"
> — Discrete-Mathematics-Laboratories/lab5_GraphTheory/SentinelNet/README.md, 2026-07-10

The generated file carries a "GENERATED from sn-app.jsx (do not edit by hand)" header and the rebuild
command lives in the README. See [[react]].

## Consistency check

The sibling app in the same lab directory does the opposite — `Q-HYDRO Wrocław` states "No
dependencies are vendored" and loads Leaflet, tiles and fonts from CDNs. Two lab-5 apps under
opposite rules, and the root README's "all run offline" overstates it. See
[[zero-dependency-no-build-step]] and [[documentation-drift]].
